text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was being interviewed by Reporter Otonashi
alongside Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It is wonderful!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"So you kept challenging the Eternal Big Three
to establish your presence as the representative of your generation, didn't you!?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly as you say.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
To finish with this many wins against the Eternal Big Three!
You truly walked the talk! That was absolutely magnificent!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
To think that such passionate feelings were behind
Yaeno Muteki-san's great record...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
It's a waste to keep it just on the printed page!
Why not convey that passion directly to everyone?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was decided that Monthly Twinkle
would host a talk show event starring Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—I pushed forward with the single-minded desire
to surpass the Eternal Big Three, and before I knew it,
the victories had simply accumulated.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Taking on the conscious responsibility of representing your generation...!
As expected of Yaeno Muteki-dono!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"You kept winning against the Eternal Big Three!
Yaeno Muteki-san represents our generation!!
I think you're the strongest!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "The strongest...! I am...!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she is the strongest!
Yaeno's victory is proof of her invincibility!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan D
text_block_list.text: Please continue to stay invincible from now on as well!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Muteki! Muteki! Muteki!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chants of 'Muteki!' echo through the venue.
Suddenly, I was struck by the sensation of standing right at the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki stands in the winner's circle
amidst a thunderous chorus of "Muteki!" cheers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Muteki! Muteki! Muteki!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...This is the sight I have yearned for all along...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
To keep wishing for it... Ah...
Do you mean cheering for Oguri-san...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, like Oguri-san, I too have strived for running that captivates people.
I believe that is the kind of presence a representative of a generation should have.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Merely winning isn't enough.
In that regard, perhaps I still haven't surpassed Oguri-san and the others.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I will deliver a run worthy of a representative of our generation and the strongest of all.
I intend to continue devoting myself fully to this path."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
In that case, count us in too!!
We'll help out however we can!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
The Oguri boom only reached this scale because the cheering spread and grew over time!
If we become the core of the cheers...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Let's form an unofficial Yaeno Muteki fan club!
That way we fans can interact with each other, too!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text: We shall lend our strength to Lord Yaeno Muteki!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ! My goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I could not be happier!!
I thank you from the bottom of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The talk show event was a massive success.
The fans who attended happily walked home
together afterward.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, to think the people cheering for me were such passionate individuals...!
choice_data_list: Maybe she's a lot like you.
Maybe she's a lot like you in that way.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is that why my chest feels so ablaze?
My fighting spirit is bubbling up from within.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, so this is what it feels like
to turn Oguri-san's cheers into power..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... A packed arena of vast crowds is marvelous, but
a deep, unyielding bond holds
a distinct beauty of its own as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How fortunate indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki smiles happily. Through the victories she had steadily accumulated, she seemed to have forged an irreplaceable bond.
